edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership stores the pending owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership finalizes ownership into owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
SmzdmToken constructor sets symbol.
SmzdmToken constructor sets name.
SmzdmToken constructor sets decimals.
SmzdmToken constructor sets _totalSupply.
SmzdmToken constructor credits the initial holder balance.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferAnyERC20Token sends rescued tokens to owner.
Deployer-controlled msg.sender becomes owner without validation.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before changing ownership.
transfer debits the caller-controlled balances[msg.sender].
approve lets msg.sender set its own allowance.
transferFrom consumes allowed[from][msg.sender] for the caller.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender] and forwards msg.sender to the callee.
to parameter influences the credited balance in transfer.
tokens parameter determines the amount moved in transfer.
spender parameter keys the allowance written in approve.
tokens parameter sets the allowance value in approve.
from parameter selects the debited balance in transferFrom.
to parameter selects the credited balance in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved and allowance spent in transferFrom.
spender parameter is both allowance key and external call target in approveAndCall.
tokens parameter sets the allowance granted in approveAndCall.
data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call.
_newOwner parameter is written to the newOwner state variable.
tokenAddress parameter is the target of the external ERC20 transfer call.
tokens parameter is the amount forwarded to the external ERC20 call.
safeAdd executes the addition operation that could overflow before the require check.
safeSub executes the subtraction operation that could underflow before the require check.
safeMul executes the multiplication operation that could overflow before the require check.
safeDiv executes the division operation guarded by a zero-divisor require.
Result of the addition is stored in local variable c in safeAdd.
Result of the subtraction is stored in local variable c in safeSub.
Result of the multiplication is stored in local variable c in safeMul.
Result of the division is stored in local variable c in safeDiv.
transfer relies on safeSub for the sender balance debit.
transfer relies on safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
transferFrom relies on safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom relies on safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
approveAndCall performs an external call to the caller-supplied spender after writing state.
transferAnyERC20Token calls an arbitrary external contract supplied as tokenAddress.
The receiveApproval callback can re-enter transferFrom using the freshly granted allowance.
